meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关故障时,Claude 会先查证据、找原因,判断该问题属于哪个 GitHub 项目,然后整理成一份英文问题报告,包含复现步骤、根因和修复建议,提交到对应仓库;它只在问题属于上游 Codex 项目时才可能创建代码修改请求(PR)。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交、打开或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等的 bug,尤其需要根因、复现步骤或 GitHub 路由时触发。

say.text: 帮我报告这个 LazyCodex 安装失败的 bug,附上复现步骤。
say.note: Claude 会调查并起草 issue 给你确认。

say.text: 这个 Codex 插件报错,帮我查根因并提交到正确的仓库。
say.note: Claude 会复现、判断归属,再准备报告。

howto.what_en: When you report a LazyCodex or Codex bug, Claude gathers evidence, finds the cause, and picks the owning GitHub repo. It drafts an English issue with reproduction steps, root cause, and fix guidance, then files it. It considers a PR only for upstream Codex.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugins, upstream Codex CLI, etc., especially when you need root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, or GitHub routing.

say_en.text: Report this LazyCodex installation failure bug with reproduction steps.
say_en.note: Claude will investigate and draft an issue for you.

say_en.text: This Codex plugin errors; find the root cause and file it in the right repo.
say_en.note: Claude will reproduce, route, and prepare the report.

say_en.text: Turn this into a GitHub issue and apply the lazycodex-generated label.
say_en.note: Claude will check duplicates, create it, and apply the label.
